name: prefix-cache-bench
description: A small benchmark that measures the performance and correctness impact of prefix/caching strategies for autoregressive transformer inference. It evaluates runtime characteristics such as latency and throughput across caching implementations while also checking that generated output remains unchanged. Useful for comparing efficiency tradeoffs of different caching/prefix approaches in LLM serving.
evaluation_method: latency_and_throughput_metrics (tokens/sec, ms per token) plus output consistency checks
general_score_metric: tokens_per_second (throughput) and latency (ms); consistency measured by output match rate
reputation: A niche systems-oriented benchmark referenced by researchers and engineers working on LLM inference and caching; modest adoption within ML systems community.
